gen-gf-goldman-gf-vend-sans: Commanding and wide-set, Goldman has round forms like open parentheses and a heading with low contrast in its lines. And Vend Sans follows in a ruler-drawn, constant-width line, its sans-serif curves ending in wide, unclosed terminals.
gen-flavors-gf-questrial: Whimsical but heavy-handed, with stubby, towering lowercase. Questrial then takes over with a flat, stencil-cut sans-serif feel, and that single-weight crispness is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-parkinsans: Grandstander is loud, chunky and open-handed. Parkinsans, a sans-serif with wide-mouthed letters and lowercase rising close to the capitals, stays crisp even when shrunk, and that sharpness is the pair's best quality.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoine: Audiowide looks like glowing tiles, spaced far apart. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, a plain sans with generous room between curve ends and stems and little height gap between cases, gives the pair its steadiest quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam reads as a clean, contemporary sans-serif, with curve tips that never touch and capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Almendra Display adds ornate, literary character above it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-yaldevi: Autour One is expressive and bold, its stems and crossbars sharing a single thickness with a minimal step from capitals to lowercase. Then Yaldevi, a neutral sans with outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, carries a long passage comfortably.
gen-eater-gf-radio-canada-big: Dark, aggressive and a bit gnarled. Eater shifts thickness softly, and Radio Canada Big follows as a sans with a monoline skeleton and terminals clear of the stem, so a roomy heading size would let that menace breathe.
gen-flavors-gf-readex-pro: Flavors brings whimsy with a commanding edge, its diagonals as hefty as its stems and its lowercase towering. Yet Readex Pro, a sans with broad terminal gaps and a unvarying weight, quiets everything down beneath it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-prompt: Prompt reads as a neutral, approachable plain sans, with oversized small letters and apertures that stay easily readable. Funnel Display above it is spaghetti-like and commanding, so the two feel playful yet orderly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-preahvihear: Goldman spreads its letters wide, round forms like open parentheses. Preahvihear, a sans-serif with a lofty x-height and mouths opened like a pried oyster shell, is the quality that makes the pair modern.
